payload.reason: The dataset was obtained from TripAdvisor, which is the world's largest online travel site, and it consists of hotel reviews collected over a period of nineteen years.

claims.text: The dataset HotelRec was created based on hotel reviews from TripAdvisor, containing approximately 50 million reviews.
HotelRec includes 50,264,531 hotel reviews collected from February 1, 2001, to May 14, 2019.
The dataset was specifically focused on reviews that included userID, itemID, rating, written text, and date.
